milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the stone brick building (centered around spawn-relative [6, 2, 6]) and face it. max_distance=10 allows the player to 'find' the building from a reasonable viewing distance while facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at the stone brick walls.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The stone brick stairs form the entrance steps at spawn-relative [6, 0, 2]. max_distance=5 requires the player to walk toward the stairs (spawn is ~6.3 blocks away), ensuring deliberate approach. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the stair blocks.
